in_marathi.name: Shobharam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Auspicious, Beautiful, Radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shobharam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shobharam means one who is radiant and beautiful. It is derived from the Sanskrit words shobhana (beautiful) and rama (pleasing). The name is often used to describe someone who is auspicious and elegant.
